Based on the provided clinical chart, the following CPT codes would be recommended:

1. 22551 - Arthrodesis, anterior interbody technique, including minimal discectomy to prepare interspace (other than for decompression); lumbar
2. 22840 - Insertion of interbody biomechanical device(s) for spinal fusion, each interspace (List separately in addition to code for primary procedure)
3. 22842 - Insertion of intervertebral biomechanical device(s) (eg, synthetic cage, mesh) for intervertebral disc space, anterior approach, including disc space preparation, discectomy, osteophytectomy, and decompression of spinal cord and/or nerve roots; thoracic
4. 76000 - Fluoroscopy (separate procedure), up to 1 hour physician time, other than 71023 or 71034 (eg, cardiac fluoroscopy)

Please note that the specific CPT codes may vary based on the details of the procedure and any additional services provided. It is recommended to consult with the billing department or a certified medical coder for accurate coding for reimbursement purposes.
